_comment: Phriend shortcut rules (#1903), read by phamos/phriend/shortcut.py and phamos/public/js/phriend/shortcut.js. A shortcut needs Mod (Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) or Ctrl, no Alt (Option types characters on a Mac, Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on Windows), and must not take over what the browser or the system does with that key.
